import pandas as pd
Table_0['date'] = pd.to_datetime(Table_0['calculationperiod']).dt.normalize()
local_agg = (
    Table_0[
        (Table_0['sliceanddicevalue1'].str.lower() == 'local')
        & (Table_0['date'] >= pd.Timestamp('2024-04-01'))
        & (Table_0['date'] <= pd.Timestamp('2024-04-30'))
    ]
    .groupby('date', as_index=False)['kpivalue']
    .sum()
    .rename(columns={'kpivalue': 'local_total'})

    Table_0[
